title: Chamber reports West Reynolds Street closure for utility repairs
excerpt: The Chamber’s 5:48 p.m. Tuesday alert reported a closure from Main Street to the NMMC Wellness Center for repairs. No reopening time was given.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County Chamber Main Street reported a partial closure of West Reynolds Street at 5:48 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 27, after damage to a utility pole and lines. Its notice identifies the affected section as the stretch from Main Street to the NMMC Wellness Center.
The Chamber said crews would remain on scene for several hours to make repairs. The notice did not provide a reopening time; this report reflects that Tuesday evening announcement.

North Mississippi Health Services lists the Pontotoc Wellness Center at 38 West Reynolds Street. Drivers planning to use the affected section should check the Chamber’s original alert, linked below, for updates before heading through the area.
